description: Answers 'which NetActuate locations are SOC 2 / HIPAA / ISO 27001 certified' across the whole footprint, and 'is NetActuate itself SOC 2 certified'. With no argument it returns netactuateCertifications, NetActuate's own as netactuate.com/compliance lists them, and every certification its facilities publish with how many sites hold each. With a certification it lists the sites whose facility holds it, each with publishedAs: the site's own wording of the certificate, as evidence, and says whether NetActuate itself holds it. A facility's certification is not NetActuate's own. Names are normalised, because the website writes some standards several ways. Use it for regulated-workload placement; to combine a certification with a region or country, use list_data_centers' certification filter instead.

certification.description: Certification to filter by, e.g. 'HIPAA', 'SOC 2 Type II', 'ISO 27001'. Naming several ('HIPAA and SOC 2') lists sites holding all of them; use 'or' for any of them.

name: get_compliance_coverage
title: Compliance coverage across the footprint
